part_1.situation:
Hamilton Shopping Mall

Visit the city's newest shopping mall.

Near the motorway (junction 9), parking for 4,000 cars.

Electric buses depart every 10 minutes from the city centre.

We have over 300 shops, including 12 department stores, plus restaurants, a cinema and a bowling alley.

Discounts and special offers are always available and change weekly.
part_1.instruction: You recently visited the shopping mall advertised above. Write a review of your visit for a customer review website.
points_to_include: your journey to the shopping centre
the variety of shops and facilities
your opinion of the special offers
